purpose: Test conditional mixture instead of a uniform four-network mean, without training on validation labels.
parameters: Raw weight .25/.75, visibility 1s mean with per-half isolation; separate alive/dead and ownership distributions; entropy comparison is unsupervised.
selection: Highest selection spellF1 with macro>=baseline-.002; freeze then test selected only on fold2; adopt if both confirmation game means improve and macro>=baseline-.002.
limitation: Previously used external games, new-round confirmation only.
